# generate-sse — Server-Sent Events Schema Generation Skill

Generate OpenAPI 3.1 YAML specifications describing Server-Sent Events
endpoints using the `SSEGenerator` class. Produce event-stream schemas with
proper event typing, reconnection semantics, and keep-alive patterns.

## Generator Interface

```
Module  : src/uptempo/schema/sse.py  (to be implemented)
Class   : SSEGenerator(SchemaGenerator)
Methods :
  generate(issue: Issue, workspace: Path) -> list[Path]
  validate(files: list[Path]) -> list[str]
Base    : src/uptempo/schema/base.py — SchemaGenerator
```

## Input

| Field | Source | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear | Issue ID (e.g., `UPT-58`) — embedded in header comment |
| `issue.title` | Linear | Short summary — becomes `info.title` seed |
| `issue.description` | Linear | Full requirements — parse for event types, streams |
| `workspace` | Orchestrator | Absolute path to `./workspaces/{issue_id}/` |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
└── sse/
    ├── {domain}-events.yaml     # Primary OpenAPI 3.1 spec
    ├── components/
    │   ├── event-schemas.yaml   # Per-event-type payload schemas
    │   └── parameters.yaml      # Shared query params (filters, auth)
    └── .spectral.yaml           # Lint ruleset with SSE extensions
```

All files include the standard header:

```yaml
# Generated by Uptempo for UPT-58: Order Status Stream
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Requirements

1. Extract event stream names from `issue.description` (e.g., "order updates", "notifications").
2. Identify discrete event types: state changes, creation events, deletion events.
3. Detect authentication method: query param token, cookie, or Authorization header.
4. Note filtering requirements: per-resource, per-user, topic-based.
5. Identify reconnection expectations: resume from last event, replay window.

### Step 2 — Initialize Workspace

```python
from uptempo.schema.sse import SSEGenerator

generator = SSEGenerator()
out_dir = workspace / "sse"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

### Step 3 — Build Spec Structure

Construct the root OpenAPI document with SSE-specific media types:

```yaml
openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: "{Domain} Event Streams"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Generated from Linear issue {issue.identifier}"
servers:
  - url: /api/v1
paths: {}
components:
  schemas: {}
  parameters: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
```

### Step 4 — Define Event Payload Schemas

Create a discriminated union of event types. Each event follows the SSE wire
format: `event`, `data`, `id`, `retry`.

```yaml
components:
  schemas:
    SSEEvent:
      description: "Base SSE event envelope"
      type: object
      required: [event, data, id, timestamp]
      properties:
        event:
          type: string
          description: "SSE event type field"
        data:
          description: "JSON-encoded payload"
        id:
          type: string
          description: "Monotonic event ID for Last-Event-ID resume"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    OrderCreated:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SSEEvent'
        - type: object
          properties:
            event:
              const: "order.created"
            data:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderPayload'

    OrderStatusChanged:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SSEEvent'
        - type: object
          properties:
            event:
              const: "order.status_changed"
            data:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/StatusChangePayload'
```

### Step 5 — Generate Stream Endpoints

Map each event stream to a GET endpoint returning `text/event-stream`:

```yaml
paths:
  /events/orders:
    get:
      operationId: streamOrderEvents
      summary: "Subscribe to order event stream"
      tags: [events]
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/LastEventId'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/EventFilter'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "SSE event stream"
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: "no-cache"
            Connection:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: "keep-alive"
            X-Accel-Buffering:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: "no"
          content:
            text/event-stream:
              schema:
                type: string
                format: event-stream
                description: |
                  Stream of newline-delimited SSE frames:
                  event: order.created
                  id: evt_001
                  data: {"orderId":"...","status":"pending"}

                  event: order.status_changed
                  id: evt_002
                  data: {"orderId":"...","from":"pending","to":"confirmed"}
              x-event-schemas:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderCreated'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderStatusChanged'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
```

### Step 6 — Add Reconnection Parameters

```yaml
components:
  parameters:
    LastEventId:
      name: Last-Event-ID
      in: header
      description: "Resume from this event ID on reconnect (set automatically by EventSource)"
      schema:
        type: string
    EventFilter:
      name: filter
      in: query
      description: "Comma-separated event types to subscribe to"
      schema:
        type: string
        example: "order.created,order.status_changed"
```

### Step 7 — Add Keep-Alive and Retry Semantics

Document the keep-alive comment pattern and default retry interval:

```yaml
x-sse-config:
  retry: 3000
  keepAliveIntervalMs: 15000
  keepAliveComment: "heartbeat"
  maxReconnectAttempts: 10
  reconnectBackoff: "exponential"
  reconnectMaxMs: 30000
```

Wire format for keep-alive:

```
: heartbeat

```

Wire format for retry directive:

```
retry: 3000

```

### Step 8 — Add Authentication

SSE uses standard HTTP auth since EventSource sends cookies and headers:

```yaml
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    cookieAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: cookie
      name: session_token
    queryTokenAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: query
      name: token
      description: "Fallback for EventSource which cannot set custom headers"

security:
  - bearerAuth: []
  - cookieAuth: []
```

### Step 9 — Write Files

```python
files = generator.generate(issue, workspace)
```

### Step 10 — Validate

```python
errors = generator.validate(files)
# Spectral lint + custom SSE rules
```

## Output Template

Minimal valid SSE spec:

```yaml
openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: "Notification Events"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Generated from Linear issue UPT-58"
servers:
  - url: /api/v1
paths:
  /events/notifications:
    get:
      operationId: streamNotifications
      tags: [events]
      parameters:
        - name: Last-Event-ID
          in: header
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: filter
          in: query
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "SSE event stream"
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema: { type: string, const: "no-cache" }
            Connection:
              schema: { type: string, const: "keep-alive" }
          content:
            text/event-stream:
              schema:
                type: string
                format: event-stream
              x-event-schemas:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationEvent'
        '401':
          description: "Unauthorized"
components:
  schemas:
    SSEEvent:
      type: object
      required: [event, data, id, timestamp]
      properties:
        event: { type: string }
        data: {}
        id: { type: string }
        timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }
    NotificationEvent:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SSEEvent'
        - type: object
          properties:
            event: { const: "notification" }
            data:
              type: object
              properties:
                title: { type: string }
                body: { type: string }
                severity: { type: string, enum: [info, warn, error] }
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
x-sse-config:
  retry: 3000
  keepAliveIntervalMs: 15000
  keepAliveComment: "heartbeat"
```

## Validation Rules

| Rule | Tool | Severity |
|------|------|----------|
| Valid OpenAPI 3.1 structure | Spectral `oas` ruleset | error |
| `text/event-stream` media type on SSE endpoints | custom `uptempo-sse-media` | error |
| `x-event-schemas` present on event-stream responses | custom `uptempo-sse-schemas` | warn |
| `Last-Event-ID` header param on every stream endpoint | custom `uptempo-sse-resume` | error |
| Event schemas have `event` field with `const` value | custom `uptempo-sse-event-type` | error |
| `Cache-Control: no-cache` response header | custom `uptempo-sse-cache` | warn |
| `x-sse-config.retry` defined | custom `uptempo-sse-retry` | warn |
| Header comment present | `_header_comment()` check | error |

Run validation:

```bash
npx @stoplight/spectral-cli lint {workspace}/sse/*.yaml --ruleset .spectral.yaml
```

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| No event types found in issue | Generate generic `data-update` event with `x-generated: placeholder` |
| Bidirectional requirement detected | Log warning, generate SSE for server→client, add comment recommending WebSocket |
| Missing authentication method | Default to Bearer JWT with `x-auth-inferred: true` |
| No reconnection requirements | Apply defaults: `retry: 3000`, keep-alive every 15s |
| Event payload structure unclear | Infer from event name, mark fields with `x-inferred: true` |
| Spectral lint failure | Return errors from `validate()`, do not delete generated files |
| Workspace directory missing | Create `sse/` directory tree automatically |
